category: financial news API (ticker-linked, relevance-scored news with per-ticker sentiment; SEC insider filings)

free_tier.stated: Free plan USD 0 forever: REST API at 20 requests per minute and 100 per day with 1 key, an MCP server at the same 20 per minute and 100 per day, a 30-day news archive, pages of up to 20 items, and Radar data delayed 60 minutes.
free_tier.notes: One HTTP request to any /api endpoint counts as one request, an empty page still counts, and on MCP only tool calls count; a request rejected with 429 spends no quota. The website news feed has no daily cap. The next plan up is Basic, listed at USD 2.99 and USD 7.99 a month in early access, with 60 requests per minute and 10,000 per day. The vendor writes the name AlphAI; its TypeScript client class and some listings write AlphaAI.

per_object_cap.stated: 20 items per page on Free (page size up to 50 on Pro), paged with a cursor

retention.stated: 30-day news archive on the Free API; a cursor or from_date window beyond the archive horizon answers HTTP 403
retention.notes: A query API with no stored objects.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 100 requests a day bound what a free key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://api.alphai.io/api/news/ with Authorization: Bearer <key>; JSON over HTTPS, cursor-paginated, with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec at https://api.alphai.io/api/schema/; server-side use only, as the API sends no CORS headers. An MCP server at https://mcp.alphai.io/mcp serves the same feed as tools and signs in with OAuth.
tooling: any HTTP client; official Python and TypeScript SDKs (alphai-sdk); an MCP server
chaining: A relevance-scored, ticker-linked news and SEC insider-filing feed at 100 requests a day, so a free stack narrows polling with min_relevance, symbol or category filters and takes prices from a quote feed such as Finnhub or Twelve Data.

limits.value: 20 requests per minute on the Free plan, per account across all keys (REST and MCP each)
100 requests per day on the Free plan, reset at 00:00 UTC
20 items per page on the Free plan

limits_note: Archive depth: 30 days on Free, and a window past it answers HTTP 403. Radar data carries an added 60-minute delay on Free. Bulk path: the insider endpoint's format=csv returns a file of up to 500 rows on Free for one request.
binding_note: 100 requests a day is met long before 20 per minute: the daily volume cap binds first.

identity_cost.detail: The register page offers Google sign-in or a direct registration; the privacy page lists email, full name and a hashed password as the account data of a direct registration and names a verification email. The developers page says a key is created in the account with no credit card. The exact fields of the form are not exposed in the page text: unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: A per-minute burst answers HTTP 429 with a short Retry-After; a window past the archive horizon answers HTTP 403; a keyless call answered HTTP 401 API key required.
confidence_note: Limits, archive depth and plan features are read from the first-party pricing, developers and OpenAPI pages, and a keyless call answered HTTP 401. A free key was not exercised, and the exact fields of the register form are not exposed in the page text, so they are unverified: behind a sign-up.
